name: nucleus
description: Nucleus — one operating system of portable AI workflows and shared memory for Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex.

plugins.name: nucleus-router
plugins.description: Use one natural-language front door to select and sequence installed Nucleus workflows across memory, operations, relationships, and planning.

plugins.name: claude-cortex
plugins.description: A host-portable Markdown second brain shared by Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.

plugins.name: lead-engine
plugins.description: Capture and score buying signals, research contacts, draft warm outreach, manage follow-up cadence, and prepare call briefs without auto-sending.

plugins.name: weekly-alignment
plugins.description: Scan configured Slack sources for cross-team alignment signals and produce daily pulses, weekly reports, and risk updates.

plugins.name: core-ops
plugins.description: Analyze CRM pipeline, review deliverables, inspect Nucleus health, record agent metrics, and register schedules when the host supports them.

plugins.name: news-curator
plugins.description: Find recent stories, rank them for a configured audience, and assemble a voice-matched roundup with traceable sources.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Create an engagement plan, portable AI workspace prompt, folder blueprint, next action, and optional Cortex nodes from approved inputs.

plugins.name: time-tracking
plugins.description: Turn calendar events into a local, reviewable time log and generate invoice drafts from configured client billing rules.

plugins.name: client-status
plugins.description: Synthesize project, calendar, CRM, and Cortex context into concise weekly client-status drafts for user review.

plugins.name: referral-engine
plugins.description: Review relationship context, cooling periods, and positive moments to prioritize referral actions and draft voice-matched asks.

plugins.name: relationships
plugins.description: Build a daily relationship cockpit, rebalance a network, and create context-aware touchpoint drafts from shared identity, voice, and memory.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Create voice-matched drafts, compare drafts with final edits, and propose durable style-rule updates only after repeated evidence. Renamed from writing-style, 2026-09-15.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: Combine calendar, tasks, outreach, inbox, CRM, and Cortex context into a daily brief, then process user-approved annotations and plan tomorrow.
